steps.title: Establish App Meta-Configuration
steps.description: Establish the application meta descriptor containing app name 'Voice Control Assistant' and package identifier 'com.voicecontrolassistant.app'.

steps.title: Configure Accessibility Service Rules
steps.description: Ensure configurations are set for retrieval of interactive window contents and view resource IDs.

steps.title: Initialize Speech Recognizer Engine
steps.description: Create background speech recognition services with explicit continuous listening modes and a 10-minute session limit.

steps.title: Optimize Command Parser Engine
steps.description: Improve regex and text parsing capabilities to correctly classify scroll directions, search queries, target applications, and clicks in English/Hinglish.

steps.title: Upgrade Click Event Processing
steps.description: Develop full recursive traversing algorithms to click target buttons or their closest clickable parents without relying on hardcoded coordinates.

steps.title: Build Multi-Scrollable Container Detection
steps.description: Optimize list/recyclerview scroll detection and prioritize deep visible containers with programmatic scroll actions.

steps.title: Implement Scroll State Comparison
steps.description: Record active layout hashes prior to scroll events to compare post-scroll screen changes and accurately report scroll success state.

steps.title: Integrate Automatic Input Submission
steps.description: Refine the typing mechanism to automatically locate target submit/search buttons, filter voice actions, and call automated submit requests.

steps.title: Formulate Multi-Stage Search Pipelines
steps.description: Establish precise temporal synchronization routines to open applications, click magnifying icons, type terms, and submit search states.

steps.title: Implement UI Transitions Validation
steps.description: Formulate a verification delay pipeline using refreshed accessibility window logs to ensure commands completed correctly.

steps.title: Building Voice Control Assistant
steps.description: Assemble, compile, and build the updated Voice Control Assistant using Gradle command line utilities.
